content_of_post_to_answer: What mindset helps you push through the physical and mental discomforts of exam preparation while working?
answer: The mindset that helps most is not treating discomfort as a sign that something is wrong, but as the natural cost of carrying two demanding roles at once. Working while preparing creates a constant negotiation between energy, ambition, and limits. The mistake is expecting motivation to bridge that gap every day. A better approach is building trust with yourself through small, repeatable commitments. Discipline becomes easier when your brain stops debating whether you will show up and starts assuming that you will.
